cross_paper.question: Compare the attention mechanism in Attention Is All You Need with the low-rank updates in the LoRA paper.

response.answer:
The model validated only part of the comparison. Exact source excerpts for the missing side(s):

LoRA takes a step further by not requiring the accumu-
lated gradient update to weight matrices to have full-rank during adaptation.

relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.
